verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own transparency note documents a Vision capability to analyze images and get insights from photos, so the product directly offers image interpretation. That is the only mention, though: screenshots, the upload/share flow, and accuracy are not documented or independently confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit screenshot support, documentation of how images are shared or uploaded, evidence of interpretation accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: See and understand. Use Vision to analyze images, get insights from photos, and search visually.
